items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Uh, there was, uh, a, a guy from out of time, uh, Professor Oins.

ctx.x: Were they, were they older than you? Oh yeah. Okay. Uh-huh. This was his kind of, his standard. Yeah, it was a small band.

It wasn't a huge band. How many? Oh. Maybe, uh, he played trumpet, I played saxophone. They had another guy who played saxophone. Uh, there was, uh, a, a guy from out of time, uh, Professor Oins. Uh-huh. Uh, trombone, he, he was a, a professor of instruments. He played piano, any instrument. Yeah. And he was the dean of the black school. Uh, at, at Grimwald?
